reviewNotes: HOLD - The University of Prishtina Faculty of Medicine officially lists General Medicine as a six-year, 360 ECTS integrated programme leading to Medical Doctor. Its international admissions page states that foreign candidates submit school records/diploma equivalency and sit the entrance exam, and says applicants do not pay registration or tuition fees. The faculty describes educational activity at the University Clinical Center and other national health institutions. Hold pending a current Medicine-specific admissions call, teaching language confirmation for the full programme, formal foreign-student eligibility/visa support, and a target-market recognition assessment.
